findings.description: The only Custom-preset locked row is masked by the vision dependency (score 1 < vision 5), so the Custom config gives no direct lock proof for a food ability; the Custom thresholds equal NORMAL's, which are proven in campaign51.

For most food abilities ATD_STAGE2A_STATE reports the ability lock state as null (18 lines each), so the lock is inferred from DENIAL_INTENT lines, Item.use Pass[] and unchanged count rather than from an explicit LOCKED state.
